deck.audience: developer advocates, open-source community managers, and engineering leaders tracking AI tooling trends

brief.title: GitHub Trending Repos Snapshot: The Rise of AI Coding Agents and Claude Code Skills
brief.one_liner: An analysis of the top 20 trending GitHub repositories in the past 24 hours reveals overwhelming dominance of AI coding agent tools, Claude Code skill extensions, and developer productivity utilities.
brief.goal: The audience should understand which categories of AI-related open-source projects are surging in popularity, identify the key repos and patterns driving the trend, and assess strategic implications for developer tooling investment.

slides.title: Claude Code Spawns an Ecosystem: Skills, Guides, Switches, and Best Practices
slides.objective: Highlight the Claude Code ecosystem.
